lead: Pick one purpose for the whole campaign. It gives our walks a reason.
These are ideas. The house rules are suggestions, not server rules.
Our quarantined list and one summon each still apply.
overviewNote: Everything here uses the base game, its add-ons and our installed mods.

orders.name: Relic Wardens
orders.idea: Carry cursed relics to one place. Seal them there.
orders.goal: Find cursed relics: Dragon Priest masks, Daedric artifacts, necromancer tomes. Seal every one in a place we choose.
rules: Relics are never sold or traded.
Choose the sealing place first. Seal every relic there.
roles: Scouts the route. Shoots tomb guards before the party enters.
Studies each relic. Fights with direct fire, frost and shock.
Guards the relic bearer in narrow tomb halls.
Keeps the bearer alive.
burns undead guards.

orders.name: Free Company
orders.idea: A band of sellswords. Take jobs and bounties from the holds.
orders.goal: Earn a name in all nine holds. Finish one job in each.
rules: Walk between holds. No fast travel.
Share job pay evenly, four ways.
Finish one job before taking the next.
roles: Opens fights from range. Takes quiet kills on bounties.
Hits groups with direct spells.
handle the rest.
Holds the front line. Takes the first hit.
Keeps the company standing between fights.

orders.name: Trading Company
orders.idea: A trading house. Carry goods between holds and guard caravans.
orders.goal: Run trade routes through all nine holds. Count every delivery.
rules: Walk the trade routes. No fast travel.
Buy goods in one hold. Sell them in another.
Guard every cargo. Never leave a caravan behind.
roles: Scouts the road ahead. Picks off bandits from cover.
Guards the caravan with direct spells.
scatters raiders.
Walks beside the wagon. Blocks arrows meant for the cargo.
Heals travellers on the road.
works on followers too.

orders.name: Antiquarians and Map-makers
orders.idea: Scholars on foot. Explore every ruin and collect lore books.
orders.goal: Fill the map and the library. Visit every ruin. Read every lore book.
rules: Describe each new place in party chat.
Use Atlas Map Markers and moreHUD to track finds.
roles: Scouts ruins quietly. Finds the safe way in.
Reads each book first.
lights dark ruins.
Leads the way through traps and draugr halls.
Heals trap wounds. Keeps the party's book list.

orders.name: Monster Hunters
orders.idea: Hunters of vampires, necromancers and dragons. Dawnguard work.
orders.goal: Keep a hunter's tally. Clear a vampire lair, a necromancer lair and a dragon. Random dragon attacks are off in our game, so dragons come through quests.
rules: Walk to every hunt. No fast travel.
Hunt as a group. Nobody chases a target alone.
Never raise corpses. One summon each.
roles: Shoots from the dark. Scouts each lair first.
Fire works well on vampires. Direct spells hit from afar.
Holds the lair door. Blocks the big hits.
burns undead. See the
build.

orders.name: Road Pilgrims
orders.idea: Faithful travellers. Visit Divine shrines and help people on the road.
orders.goal: Do one good deed in each of the nine holds. Then cross to Solstheim.
rules: Pray at every Divine shrine you pass.
Take no pay for a good deed.
roles: Hunts food for the camp. Keeps watch at night.
Guards pilgrims with direct spells.
ends a fight kindly.
Escorts the group. Stands between pilgrims and bandits.
The heart of the order.
helps strangers on the road.
